description:
Yuqi Video Home Tour helps you explore new construction homes across Southern California — including Irvine, Chino, Chino Hills, Ontario, Eastvale, Fontana and more — right inside ChatGPT.

Search by city, budget, bedrooms, property type, or school district, and browse listing cards featuring real walkthrough videos filmed at each home. Every card shows the details buyers actually need: price and price per sqft, estimated monthly payment, property tax rate, HOA fees, floor-by-floor layout, floor plans, lot details, community homesite maps, and current builder offers. Switch the card between English and Chinese with one tap.

When a home catches your eye, the card includes direct contact details for our licensed California agent Fuqiang Yun (Wilson 云山), DRE# 02167331, of YUN AI INC (DRE# 02322018) to arrange an in-person tour.

中文用户：一句话即可搜索南加州新房，观看真实看房视频，查看月供、地税、物业费与平面图，并直接联系持牌经纪人预约看房。

Listings are maintained by the brokerage and updated regularly. Prices, taxes, fees, and incentives may change and should be independently verified; payment figures are estimates, not loan offers.

defaultPrompt: Show me new construction homes in Southern California with video tours
Find new homes under $1.3 million in Chino
Generate a video tour script for a model home
